name: Rock Creek Campground (Crane Prairie)
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 251449 (123 days observed, edges closes)
note: Deschutes NF campground on the west shore of Crane Prairie Reservoir. 30 single + 2 double sites, large and spread out with many right on the lakeshore; no hookups, boat ramp + fish-cleaning stations; max site spur 40 ft. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Diamond Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 231980 (130 days observed, edges closes)
note: Umpqua NF campground on the east shore of Diamond Lake, 238 sites (many loops; loops A-G+M reservable, K/L FCFS), 51 lakeside sites, max RV 35 ft / trailer 30 ft, boat ramps. Reservable online. --Claude

name: East Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 251447 (118 days observed, edges closes)
note: USFS Deschutes NF (Bend-Fort Rock RD) campground on the east shore of East Lake inside Newberry Caldera. 29 standard non-hookup sites, drive-in, vault toilets, drinking water; RVs up to 40 ft (per-site max varies 30-40 ft). Reservable on recreation.gov. Newberry NVM day-use/vehicle pass required in addition to camping fee. --Claude

name: Gull Point Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233193 (168 days observed, edges opens)
note: USFS Deschutes NF (Bend-Fort Rock RD) campground on a point in Wickiup Reservoir along the Cascade Lakes Scenic Byway. 81 sites, drive-in, no hookups, drinking water, vault toilets, dump station; max spur/vehicle length 40 ft. Reservable on recreation.gov. --Claude

name: Lava Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 251448 (125 days observed, edges closes)
note: USFS Deschutes NF (Bend-Fort Rock RD) campground on Lava Lake on the Cascade Lakes Scenic Byway, adjacent to Lava Lake Resort/marina. 44 sites (some tent-only), drive-in, no hookups; per-site max RV varies 24-40 ft, max spur 40 ft. Reservable on recreation.gov. --Claude

name: Little Crater Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 251537 (118 days observed, edges closes)
note: USFS Deschutes NF (Bend-Fort Rock RD) campground strung along the east shore of Paulina Lake inside Newberry Caldera. ~49 sites, drive-in, no hookups; per-site spurs 20-40 ft, max spur ~30 ft (check individual sites). Reservable on recreation.gov; Newberry NVM pass required. --Claude

name: McKay Crossing Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 272230 (127 days observed, edges closes)
note: USFS Deschutes NF (Bend-Fort Rock RD) campground along Paulina Creek off the Paulina Lake Rd. 10 sites, drive-in, no hookups, vault toilets; max spur/RV length 26 ft. Reservable on recreation.gov (FCFS after late Sept). --Claude

name: South Shore Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232791 (132 days observed, edges closes)
note: Deschutes NF campground (Sisters RD) on the south shore of Suttle Lake; 38 sites (12 pull-through), gravel spurs to 40 ft, no hookups, drinking water, vault toilets, boat launch, dump stations; reservable on recreation.gov (FCFS after late Sept). --Claude

name: Bird Track Springs Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 10367551 (122 days observed, edges closes)
note: Wallowa-Whitman NF campground in the Grande Ronde River valley off Hwy 244, ~14 mi W of La Grande (I-84 exit 252). 22 wooded sites under ponderosa pines; reviewers report easy backing for larger rigs. Reservable on recreation.gov. Interpretive trail along the river across the road. --Claude

name: Timber Creek Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 234208 (116 days observed, edges closes)
note: Humboldt-Toiyabe NF (Ely RD) -- NOT an NPS site despite the RV Life 'national' tag. Duck Creek Basin on the Schell Creek Range at ~8,500 ft. Mix of single/RV sites plus group sites; tables, fire rings/grills, vault toilets, drinking water. Reservable online. Timber Creek is a perennial trout stream through the site. Access US-93/SR-486 then ~3 mi up FR-425 dirt. --Claude
